title: The Fighter's Companion to Heavy Strikes
summary: Adds meridian-driven body strikes and a firm cover to the work of those who have finished the middle courses.

title: Treatise on the Resisted Hold
summary: A treatise on keeping a lock or pin on a stronger opponent who fights it, by qi in the grip and body.

title: Reading and Breaking Stances
summary: Teaches how to read an opponent's stance and split it with a well-placed kick, shove or sweep.

title: Treatise on the Deep Body Strike
summary: A treatise on striking so that qi passes through the muscle and acts on the body beneath the surface.

title: A Guide to Fighting Several Opponents
summary: A guide to moving through a crowd of attackers so that no more than one can strike at once.

title: The Twin Palm Discipline
summary: Teaches both palms to work as a pair, one guarding the line while the other strikes from beneath it.

title: Hawk and Hand Grapple Manual
summary: A manual of grips taken from above like a hawk's talons, which pin the opponent and turn them for the throw.

title: River Basin Pressure Course
summary: A course that applies steady, flowing pressure on the body of an opponent so that qi sinks into the joints.

title: Dual-Track Throws of the Azure Court
summary: Pairs a qi-driven throw with a body throw so that the opponent faces two answers to one defence.

title: Wind-Sworn Wrestling Oath
summary: Teaches the wrestling of those sworn to the wind, where a bearing is taken at the first grip and kept to the end.

title: Fist of the Gale Plateau
summary: A fist manual of the high plateau that teaches long, striding punches thrown with the wind at the back.

title: Oath of the Open Hand
summary: Teaches how an open hand sworn to a single guard can hold, throw and strike without ever closing into a fist.
